worked_examples.title: Add or update reviewed videos in my video-packaging ledger without touching any other row (runs on your computer) on a sample input

input.root: <root: The folder every other path is relative to (the person's own working folder that holds the ledger, captions, metadata, thumbnails and review notes), put where {root} is in the command>
input.ledger: <ledger: The packaging ledger: a JSON Lines file, one row per video (video_id, source_key, channel, titles, thumbnail identity and review, caption file references, hook evidence locators), put where {ledger} is in the command>
input.source_key: <source_key: The source key: the name the person gives one channel or playlist batch in the ledger, put where {source_key} is in the command>
input.intake: <intake: The intake manifest JSON ({videos: [{video_id, title, metadata_path, transcript_path}]}), put where {intake} is in the command>
input.channel_catalog: <channel_catalog: The channel catalog JSON ({channel_id, channel_name, entries: [{video_id, title, url, duration_seconds}]}), put where {channel_catalog} is in the command>
input.review: <review: The review record JSON ({items: [{video_id, image_path, image_bytes, image_blake3, thumbnail_words, composition, title_thumbnail_relation, opening_evidence, internal_hook_evidence}]}), put where {review} is in the command>
input.coverage: <coverage: The coverage summary JSON this ledger keeps beside it, put where {coverage} is in the command>
input.source_coverage: <source_coverage: The per-source coverage list JSON, put where {source_coverage} is in the command>
input.readback: <readback: Where to write the read-back JSON of what changed, put where {readback} is in the command>
